comments.author: Wsp
comments.body: Pet skill land search can be found in Red sea west coast and apparently Veracruz. After reading some japanese blogs it may have the same % of success as smoke bomb of retreat. Can be used during PVP.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
To expand on Wsp's original post... This item is part of the Footprints with Friends (No.1) Memorial Album. It can only be found by Pets in specific land and sea zones, and does not appear even in charted landing zone item lists.

If you wish to hunt it out for your MA, your best chance of finding it is to acquire both the Pet Training skill and a pet that has Area Search (Land) or Area Search (Sea), then spam Procurement/Collection; Additional Discovery and Pet Plunder (Land and/or Sea) can also work, but potentially at much a lower probability rate. Visit the Pet Training skill page for further details and links to some handy pet guides under the comment section.

I'm not sure about ocean zones, but according to a JP blog you can find this particular Pet MA item using a Pet with Area Search (Land) skill at the following landing points:

· Red Sea West Coast
· Southeast Veracruz

Hope that helps. Cheers.
